description_en: Deletes quota rules for one or more file paths within a specified Polarlakebase instance
description_zh: 用于删除指定Polarlakebase实例下的一个或多个文件路径的配额规则
kebab_example: aliyun polardb cancel-polar-fs-file-quota --polar-fs-instance-id pfs-2ze0i74ka60700000 --file-path-ids /path1,/path2 --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelPolarFsFileQuota

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Polarlakebase instance
parameters.name: polar_fs_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The file paths. Separate multiple paths with a comma (`,`)
parameters.help_zh: 文件路径，多个路径通过`,`分隔
parameters.name: file_path_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB cluster that the application depends on
parameters.name: db_cluster_id
